decisions.statement: An artist Alan follows and Spotify names is swept once every thirty days.
An artist Alan does not follow is left alone.
The artist swept longest ago is the artist swept first.
An artist no sweep has stamped is due before any artist a sweep has stamped.
One run takes a thirtieth of the artists followed, and at least one of them.
A run finding no artist due sweeps nothing and is a run that succeeded.
An artist named outright is swept whether or not that artist is due.
A release already filed under its Spotify id is counted and not read again.
A release Spotify gives a new id is the release already filed under its title.
Spotify lists an artist's release under an id other than the id first filed.
A release nothing is filed under is read once for the length of its tracks.
A release names the unit its length is counted in as an address.
A release names the artist whose release it is as an address.
A release filed before is read whether or not its artist is named as an address.
A release arrives started by nobody and heard for none of its length.
The progress and the grade a person gave a release outlive every sweep.
A release states the day Spotify gives only where Spotify gives a whole day.
A track is filed from the album read the release itself is filed from.
Spotify answers an album read with the first fifty tracks that album carries.
A release of more than fifty tracks is filed with every track it carries.
A release filed before this sweep carried tracks is read once for its tracks.
A release whose tracks are filed is not read again for them.
A release is backfilled only on the day the artist that release belongs to is swept.
Every release Alan follows an artist for is backfilled within thirty days.
A release Spotify answers with no track is read again on every later sweep.
One artist's releases land as one commit, after that artist's own is stamped.
An artist whose sweep throws is counted failed and the sweep goes on.
A sweep finding no artist at all is thrown rather than counted as nothing to do.
A dry run reaches Spotify and writes nothing.
The songs filed are read once for a sweep rather than once for a release.
A song a swept track needs and nothing has filed is filed by the sweep.
A song the sweep files lands in the commit the track naming it lands in.

definition: the releases Spotify holds for an artist Alan follows, filed as pages
